## Change

Explain the user problem, implementation, and affected web/API/worker/connector components.

## Verification

- [ ] API tests pass
- [ ] Web lint and production build pass
- [ ] New provider behavior has mocked or approved-sandbox contract evidence
- [ ] Documentation and demo evidence are updated

## Safety review

- [ ] No OAuth tokens, credentials, account data, personal paths, uploads, or generated dependencies are committed
- [ ] Redirect URIs, scopes, retries, and rate-limit behavior are reviewed when affected
- [ ] Logs and screenshots are sanitized
